_howTo: Copy this file, replace every value, delete products you don't need (keep 3–5), then run: npm run curate -- attach <request-id> <your-file>.json. Delete the _howTo line or leave it; it's ignored.
summary: One or two friendly sentences about how you approached their look.

products.title: Short English title, e.g. White square-neck fitted top

image.alt: Describe the photo for screen readers

shop.name: Shop name as shown on Taobao
shop.qualityNote: e.g. 4 years open, consistent photos, replies in English via translation

products.reviewNote: e.g. Reviewers say the fabric is thicker than expected; colour matches photos.
products.sizingNote: e.g. Runs small — for their usual M, suggest L. Bust 86 cm on size M.
products.whyItMatches: e.g. Same square neckline and close fit as their inspiration.
